fact: The Ministry of Health reports that 91% of monthly HMIS reports were submitted on time in FY 2023/24 (89.2% the year before, 33 local governments below the national average), from a DHIS2 in which 6,546 health facilities are coded, among them 2,040 Health Centre IIIs and 3,612 Health Centre IIs, with data entry still being decentralised to facilities.
title: Annual Health Sector Performance Report Financial Year 2023/24
